design_projection.method: fast exact projection, not an optimiser: hard storage caps for the three threshold defects, the chemical q90 cap plus the raw-draw non-increase for trans-2-nonenal, the minimal-norm linear stale_hops proxy shift (chemistry columns excluded so a proxy shift cannot undo a cap), and the linear non-negativity clamp; iterated until the maximum residual is <= 1e-9
design_projection.why: per column the projection is closed form and the only coupled row is the stale_hops proxy, so the declared constraint set admits an exact projection; the residual is then recounted from the written samples.csv instead of being trusted from memory

definition.V: V = 2*mean d(G,R) - sum d(G,G)/m^2 - sum d(R,R)/n^2 (fold-standardised storage space)
definition.V_normalized: V / D_train, D_train = mean pairwise distance of the style's TRAIN rows
definition.U_signed: U = 2*mean d(G,R) - mean d(G,G) - mean d(R,R): signed diagnostic, never clipped
definition.pooling: cells weighted by n_gen; a cell with <2 real or <2 generated rows is excluded

energy_summary.denominatorNote: the two scopes have different denominators and are reported side by side, never averaged; the excluded-style subset is the styles the frozen protocol holds out of the tuning

chemical_trans_2_nonenal.statement: delivered concentration <= the source draw (chemical non-increase on the measured column)
chemical_trans_2_nonenal.enforcement: project_design caps the column at min(style TRAIN q90, the sample's own raw draw); the count above is recomputed from the WRITTEN samples.csv, not trusted from memory

sensory_t2n_proxy.label: t2n
sensory_t2n_proxy.statement: sensory t2n PROXY increase through the design projection (diagnostic only, NOT a constraint)
sensory_t2n_proxy.note: the t2n sensory label is a linear ridge proxy; an increase here does not contradict the chemical trans-2-nonenal non-increase, and this run does not impose a sensory t2n hard constraint

nonenal_versus_t2n.separation: two different propositions: the measured chemical column carries the non-increase claim; the sensory t2n label is a ridge proxy and is reported as a diagnostic. Neither is used to declare the other satisfied.

constraint_definitions.uncalibratedColumns: kept inside the observed training support only; no physical assumption imposed
constraint_definitions.floorHandling: declared floor codes and reported zeros are censored values: the audit marks them not_identifiable instead of a physical pass
constraint_definitions.energyDistanceV: V = 2*mean d(G,R) - sum d(G,G)/m^2 - sum d(R,R)/n^2 on the fold-standardised storage matrix; E_V_norm = V / D_train with D_train the mean pairwise distance of the style's TRAIN rows (q3_lib.style_dtrain, shared with the inner selection)
constraint_definitions.marginalEmpiricalSample: valid (finite, non-imputed) cells only; omega = n_eff/(n_eff+kappa) per (style, column); n_valid < 3 falls back to the declared training-pooled marginal and is labelled in marginal_state.csv
constraint_definitions.energyDistanceU: U = 2*mean d(G,R) - mean d(G,G) - mean d(R,R): a SIGNED diagnostic, can be negative, never clipped and never square-rooted
constraint_definitions.duplicateShare: fraction of rows that are exact duplicates of an earlier row of the same block
constraint_definitions.edgeFraction: fraction of cells on a declared edge (floor code / observed support min or max / 0)
constraint_definitions.density: the 231 columns are the stored chemical table; no GAN or diffusion model is used

notes: D1 fixed: only the 33 LINEAR_CALIBRATED columns are floored at 0; the 37 log10 columns are not clipped.
D2 fixed: samples_raw.csv (conditional draw) and samples.csv (constrained design) are both written.
D3 fixed: each outer fold selects (kappa, kappa_R) with its own inner folds; see per_fold_tuning.
D4 fixed: t2n is no longer a constraint; trans-2-nonenal (chemical) carries the non-increase statement.
D5 fixed: U is reported signed; diversity / duplicates / edges / marginals / dependence are measured.
D6 fixed: copy reference, dependence-free reference and a three-level copula shrinkage ladder are compared.

D7 fixed (v6): the empirical marginals, their support, the floor mass and the shrinkage weight omega = n_eff/(n_eff+kappa) use VALID observations only — the imputed matrix is passed together with the raw np.isfinite mask, so a training-median fill is never counted as an observation. Per (style, column) denominators n_valid / n_continuous / n_floor and the pooled-fallback status are landed in marginal_state.csv.

D8 fixed (v6): the inner (kappa, kappa_R) selection scores with the SAME normalised energy statistic as the outer table (V/D_train, D_train from the inner-training rows of that style), excludes cells with <2 validation rows and counts them, and keeps U signed as a diagnostic. Paired standard-normal draws are reused across the grid so the grid comparison is not driven by draw noise.

v6 artifacts: samples_raw.csv / samples.csv / samples_difference.csv / sensory_profiles.csv (50-label ridge profile of every written spectrum) / tuning_table.csv / marginal_state.csv / energy_summary.csv are written as bodies, not only as summary numbers.

v6 separation: the chemical trans-2-nonenal non-increase and the sensory t2n proxy increase are counted separately (nonenal_versus_t2n); an increase in the proxy does not contradict the chemical statement, and no sensory t2n hard constraint is imposed in this run.
The sensory profile is a ridge-proxy diagnostic validated on REAL outer-fold beers; the profile of generated spectra is never an independent sensory validation.
Floor-coded and reported-zero cells are censored values; the audit reports them as not_identifiable.
This run uses the 231 stored columns; the 226+5 derived-feature identities are NOT verified here.
